confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from an RBA figure for 18 Nov 2026 (0.6720 USD per AUD). The search summary cited the RBA exchange-rates page for it, but I did not open that page myself. Coffee, beer and inexpensive-meal prices come from one search of crowdsourced cost-of-living data: cappuccino about CHF 4.7–5.7, local beer about CHF 6–7.25, inexpensive meal about CHF 21–24. The mid-range meal for two is an estimate from my general knowledge of Swiss prices (about CHF 110–130). Cocktail and wine prices were not searched; I estimated them from their usual price relationship to beer in Switzerland. Accommodation prices are my own estimates for July peak season, not checked against any listings, so they are the least certain anchors. I converted CHF to USD at about 1.24, which is my assumption for 2026 and was not looked up.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bern is the Swiss capital. Restaurant prices are slightly below the Swiss average and a little below Zurich and Geneva. Accommodation is set close to Basel and Lucerne in summer, with hostel dorm beds that are high by European standards.
